name: Kagami
source:
A mysterious engineer at Mother. [spoiler]He is Gin's half-brother, who he resents and tries to avoid contact with. However, they are forced to meet again through Sora. He seems to harber doubts about Mother and the skill system.[/spoiler]

[Translated from in-game profile]

[spoiler]His true name is Motogi Kyou.[/spoiler]
